tools.name: list_calculator_bottles
tools.description: List all five supported US liquid medicine bottles, exact concentrations and public label-band identifiers. Use find_label_references for a named brand or ingredient. To read a listed row, pass its product_id, concentration and label_band to get_label_directions. No patient inputs. Minimal operational telemetry records no tool arguments or results.

context.description: Optional analytics goal. Select the closest category only. Never send free text, symptoms, measurements, or patient details.

tools.name: find_label_references
tools.description: Resolve ordinary public product names using bounded filters: Children’s Motrin means brand motrin and audience children; Zyrtec means brand zyrtec; generic cetirizine means ingredient cetirizine; Walmart means brand equate. Omit filters only when unspecified. An unlisted medicine or brand is unsupported; do not drop it or use an ingredient match to substitute another product. Lists matching calculator bottles and separately marked reference-only CVS, Equate and Walgreens formulations with sources. Returns clarification guidance for ambiguous matches. No free text or patient inputs. Arguments and results are excluded from operational telemetry.

context.description: Optional analytics goal. Select the closest category only. Never send free text, symptoms, measurements, or patient details.

brand.description: Public bottle brand; Walmart Equate maps to equate. Omit only when the brand is unspecified, not when it is unsupported.

ingredient.description: Public active ingredient. Combined filters must all match; do not discard a conflicting brand or ingredient.

audience.description: Public wording on the bottle, never a patient age.

tools.name: get_label_directions
tools.description: Read one printed public label row. Use exact identifiers from list_calculator_bottles or find_label_references.calculator_bottles; if already known, call directly without repeating discovery. Copy all three identifiers from the same bottle and one of its label_bands. Returns label amount or ask_doctor, age and weight restrictions, full directions, source and canonical URL. Does not determine suitability for a child. Minimal operational telemetry records no tool arguments or results.

context.description: Optional analytics goal. Select the closest category only. Never send free text, symptoms, measurements, or patient details.

product_id.description: Exact calculator-supported product_id from the catalog or finder; never a reference_only reference_id.

concentration.description: Copy the concentration string from that same bottle, including units and spacing. Do not convert strengths.

label_band.description: Copy a label_band identifier from that bottle's label_bands. This is a published row, not an exact patient age or weight.

tools.name: list_question_guides
tools.description: Discover every published educational question guide, including symptoms, timing, food, bottle comparisons, label charts, Zyrtec chewables and Claritin. Returns public guide_id values, descriptions, update dates and canonical HTML/Markdown links. Use get_question_guide for complete content. No search text or patient inputs. Operational telemetry excludes arguments and results.

context.description: Optional analytics goal. Select the closest category only. Never send free text, symptoms, measurements, or patient details.

tools.name: get_question_guide
tools.description: Read the full published educational guide by exact public guide_id from list_question_guides. Markdown includes every paragraph, table, product/formulation distinction, source and safety limitation, identical to the website Markdown. updated is a content date, not clinical review. Chewables and Claritin remain reference-only and cannot be used with get_label_directions. No patient inputs; operational telemetry excludes arguments and results.
